item.title: Zellner wins special election for 61st District Senate seat
item.description: BUFFALO, N.Y. (WIVB) -- Erie County Democratic Committee Chair Jeremy Zellner has won the special election for the seat in New York's 61st Senate District. With 98% of the vote counted, Zellner had 18,752 votes (59.52%) and Republican candidate Dan Gagliardo had 12,591 votes (39.96%).
